summary: BrightSpire Capital, Inc. subsidiaries entered into a Purchase and Sale Agreement to sell two industrial properties (the Net Lease 1 Investment) in Tolleson, AZ and Tracy, CA to ALTOAZ001 LLC and ALTRCA001 LLC (Purchasers) for $300M total consideration (earnest money deposit of $6M; GAAP carrying value ~$239M, undepreciated ~$306M inclusive of $14M straight-line rent receivable). The sale supports BrightSpire's strategy to rotate from owned real estate into first mortgage loans. Closing expected by September 14, 2026, contingent on Purchaser's assumption of mortgage and mezzanine loans (subject to lender approval). Watch for lender approval and customary conditions; no break fee mentioned.
